features: Analog Turbo HD (TVI) camera — HD-over-coax to a Turbo HD DVR; not an IP camera
EXIR 2.0 infrared supplement light, up to 30 m
PoC (power over coax) — power and HD video on one coaxial cable
release_notes: The Hikvision DS-2CE56D0T-IT1E is a 2 MP analog Turbo HD (TVI) PoC fixed turret camera that carries power and HD video on one coaxial cable, with EXIR 2.0 infrared, a PIR sensor and an IP67 housing. It is an HD-over-coax camera for a Turbo HD DVR, not an IP camera. Verified against the official Hikvision datasheet (DS-2CE56D0T-IT1E).
